children.name: I’m passionate about drawing, graphic design, and visual storytelling. I enjoy exploring creativity through animation, digital art, and graphic design, while drawing inspiration from stories, characters, and human emotions. I’m currently learning Blender to expand my skills in 3D modelling and animation. I love combining imagination with technique to bring ideas to life through compelling visuals.
